rationale: Blind, edge-case, and acceptance lenses all ran. One confirmed major defect: MetricCard.tsx's metric.description paragraph dropped its explicit leading-5 (20px) in favor of text-h5's bundled 16px line-height while keeping line-clamp-3, shrinking the 3-line clamp box from 60px to 48px and increasing truncation risk against the 'no text clipping/truncation' AC (CR-001). One design judgment call needs explicit sign-off: MetricCard.tsx's metric value dropped the responsive 'sm:text-xl' step-up for a flat text-h3, flagged independently by both the edge-case and acceptance lenses as flattening value prominence on sm+ viewports against the 'consistent font styling' / 'visual hierarchy at viewport sizes' ACs (CR-002); this matches a decision already made in plan.md but two independent lenses re-surfacing it means it should be confirmed rather than silently accepted. Dismissed after direct verification: blind lens's 'possible missing cn import' (cn was already imported in MetricCard.tsx before this diff) and 'BarChartWidget/MetricCard label leading-4 dropped' (text-h5's bundled 16px line-height exactly matches the dropped leading-4, no change). Deferred to the plan's existing Final Verification manual check (not blocking this gate): edge-case lens's SessionTimeline.tsx w-52 detail panel value crowding risk (text-sm->text-h3) — plan.md Review Focus and Task 5 Step 10 already call for this exact manual check before MR. 2 blind-lens concerns (no mapping-table visibility, no visual-verification evidence) dismissed as artifacts of the lens's intentional isolation (no repo/plan access) — the mapping exists in plan.md's semantic tier table and manual visual verification is scheduled in Final Verification.

findings.title: Metric description line-clamp-3 box shrinks, raising truncation risk
findings.problem: The description paragraph changed from `text-[11px] leading-5 line-clamp-3` to `text-h5 line-clamp-3`, dropping the explicit `leading-5` (20px). text-h5 bundles lineHeight: 16px (tailwind.config.ts:529), so the 3-line clamp box shrinks from 60px to 48px.
findings.impact: Longer metric descriptions that previously fit within 3 lines at 60px may now get cut off within the smaller 48px box, directly threatening the AC 'No text clipping, overlapping, or unintended truncation occurs.'
findings.recommendation: Keep the original line-height alongside the new token, e.g. `cn('mt-1 text-h5 leading-5 line-clamp-3', mutedTextClassName)`, so only the font-size changes and the clamp box height is preserved.

findings.title: Metric value loses its sm+ responsive size step-up
findings.problem: valueClassName's default changed from `text-lg sm:text-xl ...` (18px mobile, 20px on sm+) to a flat `text-h3` (16px at every breakpoint), removing the responsive growth.
findings.impact: On sm+ viewports the primary metric value no longer stands out relative to its label the way it did before; both the edge-case and acceptance lenses independently flagged this against the 'consistent font styling' and 'visual hierarchy at viewport sizes' ACs. plan.md Task 3 Step 2 already made this call (snap to one token, no new responsive variant), but two independent review lenses re-surfacing it means it should be confirmed by the user rather than silently kept.
findings.recommendation: Either confirm the flat text-h3 is acceptable (matches the plan's 'snap to nearest token, no new tokens' strategy), or restore a size step via an existing token pair the user is willing to approve.
